title: Provider Policy Eligibility — is this authenticated connection PERMITTED for this execution context
description: Technical authentication does not imply contractual permission. Routing defaults conservatively and never treats UNKNOWN as allowed.

allowed_execution_contexts.description: Extensible. Well-known: HOST_NATIVE_INTERACTIVE, HOST_NATIVE_PLUGIN, LOCAL_EXTERNAL_WORKER, NONINTERACTIVE_CLI, CI_AUTOMATION, TEAM_SERVICE, CLOUD_SERVICE.

evidence_source.description: URL or document reference for the policy determination.

evidence_label.description: GENERATED from evidence_labels in evidence/SOURCE_CLAIM_REGISTRY.json. Preserves the exact authoritative label; provenance is never collapsed.

source_claim_id.description: Exact registry claim id (e.g. C-10). Ties this record to the authoritative source rather than restating it.
